key_idea: Each third of the way takes the same time.
steps: One third of the way takes 15 minutes.

choice_feedback.A: 15 minutes is only one third of the way.
choice_feedback.B: 30 minutes is only two thirds of the way.
choice_feedback.D: 1 hour is 15 + 15 + 15 + 15 minutes. That is one third too many.
choice_feedback.E: 1 hour 15 minutes is 5 lots of 15 minutes, but the way has only 3 thirds.
